name: t3code
description: Installs T3 Code CLI on Wolfi base images and optionally starts a persistent headless T3 server for DevPod workspaces.

version.description: Select the T3 Code CLI npm package version to install.

nodeVersion.description: Node.js version to install when T3 Code installation requires adding Node tooling. Existing node installations are reused.

autoStart.description: Whether to start a headless T3 Code server from the feature postStartCommand.

baseDir.description: T3CODE_HOME/base directory for server state. Mount this from the host to persist T3 state.

host.description: Host/interface for the T3 server to bind.

port.description: Port for the T3 server to listen on.

workspaceDir.description: Workspace directory passed to T3. Empty means use the postStartCommand working directory.
